mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.teacher_user_id, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_content, d.academic_year, CAST(d.semester_code AS integer) AS semester, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ids
FROM education_achievements a JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a, d
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE >= effective_start_date AND (effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= effective_end_date) ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC, mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM detail_codes WHERE group_id = 'EDUCATION_SEMESTER' AND code_value = #{semester} AND system_use_yn = 'Y' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (valid_start_date IS NULL OR valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (valid_end_date IS NULL OR valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED') AND deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE lecture_improvement_achievement_details SET performance_content = #{body.achievementContent}, academic_year = #{body.academicYear}, semester_code = CAST(#{body.semester} AS varchar) WHERE achievement_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT', #{id}, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', #{userId}, #{requestId})
